methods.annual_return: continuous account equity last close / prior year last close -1; 2020 initial cash
methods.exact_daily_attribution: prior quantity*(current close-prior close) + buys quantity*(current close-fill price) - sells quantity*(current close-fill price) - current date fees; sum reconciles every account equity change with absolute tolerance 1e-6 yuan
methods.cycle_attribution: each cycle contribution allocated by actual mark-to-market day, grouped by calendar year. Whole-trade net return separately reported and never substituted for calendar return
methods.features: normalized HFQ execution daily OHLCV from same precheck binding, affine global scale invariant range/return/acf; causal signal-date features at entry. All analysed 2022/2023 features have sufficient past windows
methods.fees_counterfactual: gross trading-price change adds back actual fees arithmetically only; does not recalculate fee-free sizing or signals
methods.selection: six old qualifying plus eleven negative-year-positive configurations and three frequency/near-frontier controls, all chosen after full pool seen
methods.entry_state_grouping: Features on BUY fill record signal_date, which can be later than the first target=1 decision after delayed limit fills. Thus e.g.C0315 fill-signal ACF may be<0.1 even though first target-entry passed ACF>=0.1; groups are descriptive actual execution states, not a replay of a new entry filter.

mechanisms_and_falsifiable_controls.hypothesis: Broad long exposure during sustained decline produces negative price PnL; a causal persistence/price-direction state filter can exclude adverse entries, but may lose too much frequency and bull-period return.
facts: C0385 2022 holds 200/242 closes, gross trading-price contribution -14.2296%, fee contribution -4.2658%, net -18.4954%. 2023 gross +0.1975% and fees -4.1638%.
C0315 differs from C0195 only acf_min None to 0.1; 2022 exposure falls 217 to 71 closes, annual net rises -10.1795% to +0.6972%; 2023 exposure falls 206 to 82, annual net rises +0.7936% to +7.2238%.
mechanisms_and_falsifiable_controls.proposed_control: Factorial acf threshold None/0/0.025/0.05/0.075/0.1 with hold horizon 3/4/6/8/9; exact fixed other parameters at C0195 and separately C0385; test momentum20>=0 only as additional separate factor. Keep all four unchanged economic gates and complete formal accounts.
mechanisms_and_falsifiable_controls.falsification: If lowering acf to restore >=110 closes makes either 2022 or 2023 <=0, sparse selective persistence does not deliver the needed combination. If price direction alone removes profits/return without achieving all gates, reject direction-filter route as sufficient.
mechanisms_and_falsifiable_controls.caution: Positive return autocorrelation measures serial persistence, not upward trend direction. ACF alone cannot identify bull states. Real account differences include changed re-entry and cash sizing; diagnostics do not establish generic causal efficacy.

mechanisms_and_falsifiable_controls.hypothesis: A state-dependent entry route may combine selective persistent-regime trades with deeper short-horizon reversion entries outside persistent states; shorter holds may produce more opportunities while excluding broad declining exposure.
facts: All eleven configurations positive in both benchmark-negative years have 3-56 closed trades and fail net annualized return. C0058 uses 60-day range entry0.3 exit0.65 acf_min -0.3 hold12, yielding +3.4953%/+4.0519% in2022/2023 but only47closed and7.3743% CAGR.
C0315 uses permissive120-day entry0.85 with acf>=0.1, giving56closed and7.5450%CAGR. Their distinct causal states provide a combination hypothesis, not proof of complementarity.
mechanisms_and_falsifiable_controls.proposed_control: Predeclare same-date state split acf>=threshold for persistence route versus acf<threshold for stricter short-window low-range entry. Controls persistence-only, deep-reversion-only, unconditional union, and causal state-conditioned union. Declare conflict priorities, common exit/holding policy, and lower entry/hold controls before evaluations. Do not use calendar year or future BuyHold sign as decision input.
mechanisms_and_falsifiable_controls.falsification: Reject the state split if the causal combination cannot exceed both constituent frequency while maintaining strictly positive2022/2023 and full original goals, or if unrestricted union performs equivalently and the state split adds no incremental effect.
mechanisms_and_falsifiable_controls.caution: Combining fills is nonlinear with one all-in account; adding standalone ledgers cannot prove a combined strategy result. Must evaluate actual SRT/TXE account. Choosing models after two loss years were seen adds selection bias.

mechanisms_and_falsifiable_controls.hypothesis: In2023 repeated weak-edge turnover consumed nearly all gross profit; avoiding re-entry without sufficient new information or shortening nonproductive exposure could improve net edge, with a hard frequency tradeoff.
facts: C0385 2023 price PnL is only +0.1975% of opening equity, while actual fees are4.1638%; fee-free arithmetic alone yields weak positivity and does not rescue2022.
Strongest2023 losing cycle10/12-10/24 has annual mark-to-market loss83558.85yuan;8/15-8/25 loses63288.49yuan;8/2-8/14 loses53097.28yuan.
mechanisms_and_falsifiable_controls.proposed_control: Use exact policy controls for re-entry state change, cooldown0/1/2, and holding horizons3/4/6/8; retain real10bp fees. Compare trade counts, fee drag, gross trading contribution, and four gates. Keep stop or momentum filters isolated before combining.
mechanisms_and_falsifiable_controls.falsification: If net improvement comes only from lowering actual transaction cost assumption or frequency below110, reject it as a compliant solution; if gross2022 PnL remains negative the turnover hypothesis is insufficient.
mechanisms_and_falsifiable_controls.caution: Arithmetic fees added back do not reproduce a zero-fee account: cash sizing and compounding would change. Cooldown and horizon have interactions with signal-derived holding anchors and delayed limit fills.

limitations: Entire 2020-2026 development pool and these loss years already viewed and reused. Post-selection diagnostics do not provide independent validation or causal proof.
Full-trade PnL allocated to exit year is not used; across-year contributions remain split by actual ledger day.
No additional datasets or dependencies, no new strategy evaluation, and no platform modifications.
Long-only/cash can avoid losses but cash alone cannot satisfy strictly positive yearly return.

Fill-signal state bins do not reconstruct the first target-entry signal; delayed LIMIT orders may enter later and state parameters/compounding interact. Use formal whole-account reevaluation for all suggested filters.
